WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-95.980531 36.750176, -95.980432 36.750269, -95.978962 36.750097, -95.979067 36.749607, -95.97871 36.749564, -95.978764 36.749291)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-84.491906 33.849766, -84.491975 33.849735, -84.492002 33.849655, -84.491999 33.849551, -84.491991 33.849313)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Tunnel System' ELSE 'Edgartown Lane Southeast' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

edgartown_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-84.491906 33.849766, -84.491975 33.849735, -84.492002 33.849655, -84.491999 33.849551, -84.491991 33.849313)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
tunnel_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(r.rast, t.geom, true))) AS slope_stats
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    tunnel_geom t
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, t.geom)
),
edgartown_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(r.rast, e.geom, true))) AS slope_stats
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    edgartown_geom e
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, e.geom)
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN t.slope_stats.avg > e.slope_stats.avg THEN 'Tunnel System'
    WHEN t.slope_stats.avg < e.slope_stats.avg THEN 'Edgartown Lane Southeast'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS steeper_feature,
  t.slope_stats.avg AS tunnel_avg_slope,
  e.slope_stats.avg AS edgartown_avg_slope
FROM 
  tunnel_slope t,
  edgartown_slope e;
